label: Three.js PvP rewards
summary: Connect a browser PvP game to bounded token rewards without trusting a client-reported winner.
requiredFacts: Round identity, participants, win condition, payout formula and maximum loss
Authoritative outcome source and why the browser cannot self-award
Replay, duplicate kill, draw, disconnect, timeout and dispute behavior
Sybil, collusion, botting, signer compromise and rate-limit controls
requiredTests: Replay, duplicate outcome and cross-round rejection
Simultaneous kill, draw, disconnect and expiry handling
Payout cap, solvency, collusion and signer-rotation scenarios
risks: Sybil or collusion can drain a reward pool
Ambiguous round finality can pay twice
